understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly matched that goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move cost one stamina point, and reaching zero stamina cost a life before resetting stamina. Walls blocked movement, and blocked_directions had to be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycled colors orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation modifiers turned the piece 90° clockwise. A goal activated only when all three attributes matched, and completing all goals advanced to the next level; losing all lives ended the game.
